unit_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production game sprite atlas, NOT a poster. Use the attached Pocket Kingdoms illustration ONLY as style reference: premium 3D tabletop miniature, chunky cute adult proportions with serious equipment, softly sculpted materials, clean readable silhouettes. True transparent background with NO background gradient, no shadows outside each cell, no text, no labels, no frames, no terrain bases. Exactly SIX separate isolated full-body game sprites in a strict 3-column by 2-row grid, 1536x1024 canvas, six equal 512x512 cells. Every sprite including weapon/horse fully inside its own cell with at least 45px padding; never crosses cell edges. Each sprite centered horizontally in its cell, feet/wheels aligned at y=455 inside cell. Orthographic isometric 3/4 view facing southeast (screen lower right), camera looking down 25 degrees. Consistent light from upper left. Human sprites about 360px tall including helmet/hat, cavalry about 390px tall, siege 390px wide. Crisp visible shapes, no motion blur or particles. ROLE ORDER is mandatory: top-left Villager holding mallet with work satchel; top-middle Warrior with spear AND shield; top-right female bow infantry with clearly visible bow; bottom-left armored mounted Horseman holding spear; bottom-middle lightly dressed mounted Scout, no armor and short spotting staff, visually distinct from Horseman; bottom-right wooden wheeled Siege engine with throwing arm, no human attached. Each exactly one complete sprite.
building_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for Pocket Kingdoms. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: premium polished 3D tabletop miniatures, chunky charming but serious medieval architecture, soft carved forms, painted stone/timber materials, warm upper-left light, crisp readable silhouettes. True transparent alpha background; NO background, NO gradients or scenery between sprites, NO text or labels, NO grids or frames, no people or units. Exactly TEN individual buildings in a strict 4-column x3-row grid on a 2048x1536 canvas. Every cell exactly512x512, every building including flags fully inside its cell with minimum45px padding, no overlap across cells. Consistent orthographic isometric view, camera elevated30degrees, two visible sides, front faces screen lower right. Each building has a small diamond-shaped ground footprint fitted beneath it; base centered at y425 inside its cell. Complete standalone objects not cropped. Large buildings maximum420px wide, tower maximum400px tall; simple small buildings300px wide. MANDATORY exact cell order: row1 col1 TOWN CENTER with civic tower and hall, col2 SMALL HOUSE with chimney, col3 BARRACKS with shields and spear racks, col4 ARCHERY RANGE with roofed shelter and round target. Row2 col1 STABLE with open horse stalls and hay but no horses, col2 FARM rectangular wheat plot and tiny fence (no big building), col3 RESOURCE CAMP open timber canopy with log pile and sacks, col4 SIEGE WORKSHOP large open timber assembly shed, crane and wheel. Row3 col1 BLACKSMITH stone forge with chimney, glowing hearth and anvil, col2 WATCH TOWER slender fortified lookout, col3 and col4 must be completely empty transparent cells. Keep every role recognizable at small game scale. NO weapons floating detached, no circular platforms. Match reference art's premium miniature material finish.
